name: Infantry_Plugins
author: Infantry AI
description: Agent tools over the plugin manager: list, search, show and status are read-only; request asks the owner to install a plugin with the grants shown. Daemon half only.

tools.name: infantry_plugin_list
tools.description: Every plugin on this host: version, class, tier, enabled, grants, licence, update offer.

tools.name: infantry_plugin_search
tools.description: Search the plugin catalogs by text and tag.

tools.name: infantry_plugin_show
tools.description: Check a plugin reference and show its class, signer, licence and requested grants (installs nothing).

tools.name: infantry_plugin_list_import
tools.description: Import a plugin list (file path or URL) as a community catalog source. Installs nothing.

tools.name: infantry_plugin_request
tools.description: Ask the owner to install a plugin with the grants it requests. Nothing is installed until the owner answers yes.
